details:
* Rebase to OpenJDK 11.0.33.1+1 (November 2026 CPU), built from the
     jdk-11.0.33.1+1 tag of the upstream jdk11u repository; the orig tarball
     is produced as by 'debian/rules get-orig'. This picks up every upstream
     security fix released since 11.0.23 (see the unstable entries below
     for the per-release CVE lists).
   * Security fixes in 11.0.33.1:
     - CVE-2026-114939: Enhance Kerberos tickets
     - CVE-2026-114940: Improve TLS client connections
     - CVE-2026-114943: Enhance JFR Events
     - CVE-2026-114944: Enhance JMX Connections
     - CVE-2026-114946: Enhance loop handling
   * Rebase the packaging onto the Debian 11.0.32.1+1-1 packaging, in the same
     form as shipped for bullseye ELS, and backport it to buster:
     - rules: disable the build-time testsuite on buster; the testsuite needs
       jtreg7 (>= 7.3.1), and buster only has jtreg6.
     - rules: don't run update-license from update-control-files; the
       copyright generator needs a newer Python than the one in buster.
     - control: regenerated for buster (g++-8, pkg-config,
       libfontconfig1-dev, libfreetype6-dev; no debugedit and
       strip-nondeterminism).
   * Bundled timezone data is now tzdata2026f.
   * Drop patches applied upstream or no longer used by the Debian packaging:
     disable-thumb-assertion.patch, riscv64.diff, loong64-autoconf-config.diff,
     jtreg-location.diff and the tzdata2026c / CLDR metazone set
     (jdk-8339644, jdk-8339803, jdk-8339637, jdk-8340552, jdk-8347965,
     jdk-8352097, jdk-8352716, jdk-8373476, jdk-8379035, jdk-8383175,
     jdk-8381379, jdk-8390388, jdk-8390380, jdk-8388214, jdk-8391256,
     jdk-8391807).
